targets.rawSql: SELECT count() as value FROM otel_traces WHERE ServiceName = 'news-app' AND SpanKind = 'Server' AND Timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 3 HOUR

SELECT round(100.0 * countIf(toUInt16OrZero(SpanAttributes['http.response.status_code']) >= 500) / count(), 2) as value FROM otel_traces WHERE ServiceName = 'news-app' AND SpanKind = 'Server' AND Timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 3 HOUR
SELECT round(quantile(0.95)(Duration / 1000000), 2) as value FROM otel_traces WHERE ServiceName = 'news-app' AND SpanKind = 'Server' AND Timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 3 HOUR

SELECT round(100.0 * countIf(toUInt16OrZero(SpanAttributes['http.response.status_code']) < 500) / count(), 2) as value FROM otel_traces WHERE ServiceName = 'news-app' AND SpanKind = 'Server' AND Timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 3 HOUR
SELECT max(Value) as value FROM otel_metrics_sum WHERE ServiceName = 'news-app' AND MetricName = 'jvm.thread.count' AND TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 5 MINUTE
SELECT max(Value) as value FROM otel_metrics_sum WHERE ServiceName = 'news-app' AND MetricName = 'jvm.class.count' AND TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 5 MINUTE
SELECT toStartOfMinute(Timestamp) as time, count() as `requests/min` FROM otel_traces WHERE ServiceName = 'news-app' AND SpanKind = 'Server' AND $__timeFilter(Timestamp) GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

SELECT toStartOfMinute(Timestamp) as time, round(quantileIf(0.50)(Duration / 1000000, 1=1), 2) as p50, round(quantileIf(0.95)(Duration / 1000000, 1=1), 2) as p95, round(quantileIf(0.99)(Duration / 1000000, 1=1), 2) as p99 FROM otel_traces WHERE ServiceName = 'news-app' AND SpanKind = 'Server' AND $__timeFilter(Timestamp) GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

SELECT SpanAttributes['http.request.method'] as method, SpanAttributes['http.route'] as endpoint, count() as request_count, round(quantile(0.50)(Duration / 1000000), 2) as p50_ms, round(quantile(0.95)(Duration / 1000000), 2) as p95_ms, round(quantile(0.99)(Duration / 1000000), 2) as p99_ms, round(100.0 * countIf(toUInt16OrZero(SpanAttributes['http.response.status_code']) >= 500) / count(), 2) as error_rate_pct FROM otel_traces WHERE ServiceName = 'news-app' AND SpanKind = 'Server' AND $__timeFilter(Timestamp) GROUP BY method, endpoint ORDER BY p99_ms DESC LIMIT 20

panels.title: Error Endpoints — Top by Error Count

targets.rawSql: SELECT SpanAttributes['http.route'] as endpoint, SpanAttributes['http.request.method'] as method, count() as total_requests, countIf(toUInt16OrZero(SpanAttributes['http.response.status_code']) >= 500) as errors, round(100.0 * countIf(toUInt16OrZero(SpanAttributes['http.response.status_code']) >= 500) / count(), 2) as error_pct FROM otel_traces WHERE ServiceName = 'news-app' AND SpanKind = 'Server' AND $__timeFilter(Timestamp) AND endpoint != '' GROUP BY endpoint, method HAVING errors > 0 ORDER BY errors DESC LIMIT 20

SELECT countIf(SpanAttributes['http.response.status_code']='200') as `HTTP 200`, countIf(SpanAttributes['http.response.status_code']='201') as `HTTP 201`, countIf(SpanAttributes['http.response.status_code']='204') as `HTTP 204`, countIf(SpanAttributes['http.response.status_code']='400') as `HTTP 400`, countIf(SpanAttributes['http.response.status_code']='401') as `HTTP 401`, countIf(SpanAttributes['http.response.status_code']='403') as `HTTP 403`, countIf(SpanAttributes['http.response.status_code']='404') as `HTTP 404`, countIf(SpanAttributes['http.response.status_code']='500') as `HTTP 500`, countIf(SpanAttributes['http.response.status_code']='502') as `HTTP 502`, countIf(SpanAttributes['http.response.status_code']='503') as `HTTP 503` FROM otel_traces WHERE ServiceName = 'news-app' AND SpanKind = 'Server' AND $__timeFilter(Timestamp)

SELECT countIf(SpanAttributes['http.request.method']='GET') as GET, countIf(SpanAttributes['http.request.method']='POST') as POST, countIf(SpanAttributes['http.request.method']='PUT') as PUT, countIf(SpanAttributes['http.request.method']='DELETE') as DELETE, countIf(SpanAttributes['http.request.method']='PATCH') as PATCH FROM otel_traces WHERE ServiceName = 'news-app' AND SpanKind = 'Server' AND $__timeFilter(Timestamp)

SELECT toStartOfMinute(TimeUnix) as time, concat(Attributes['http.request.method'], ' ', Attributes['http.route']) as metric, round(avg(Sum / Count) * 1000, 2) as value FROM otel_metrics_histogram WHERE ServiceName = 'news-app' AND MetricName = 'http.server.request.duration' AND Count > 0 AND $__timeFilter(TimeUnix) GROUP BY time, metric ORDER BY time

SELECT toStartOfMinute(TimeUnix) as time, round(sumIf(Value, Attributes['jvm.memory.type']='heap') / 1073741824, 3) as `heap`, round(sumIf(Value, Attributes['jvm.memory.type']='non_heap') / 1073741824, 3) as `non-heap` FROM otel_metrics_sum WHERE ServiceName = 'news-app' AND MetricName = 'jvm.memory.used' AND $__timeFilter(TimeUnix) GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

panels.title: JVM GC Duration Over Time (avg ms)

targets.rawSql: SELECT toStartOfMinute(TimeUnix) as time, round(avg(Sum / Count) * 1000, 2) as `avg-gc-ms` FROM otel_metrics_histogram WHERE ServiceName = 'news-app' AND MetricName = 'jvm.gc.duration' AND Count > 0 AND $__timeFilter(TimeUnix) GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

SELECT toStartOfMinute(TimeUnix) as time, max(Value) as threads FROM otel_metrics_sum WHERE ServiceName = 'news-app' AND MetricName = 'jvm.thread.count' AND $__timeFilter(TimeUnix) GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

SELECT Timestamp as timestamp, Body as body, SeverityText as level, ServiceName FROM otel_logs WHERE ServiceName = 'news-app' AND SeverityText IN ('WARN','ERROR') AND $__timeFilter(Timestamp) ORDER BY Timestamp DESC LIMIT 200
SELECT Timestamp as timestamp, Body as body, SeverityText as level, ServiceName FROM otel_logs WHERE ServiceName = 'news-app' AND $__timeFilter(Timestamp) ORDER BY Timestamp DESC LIMIT 200
